note: LONG_TERM_GUIDANCE is a section of REPLY_VOICE_SYSTEM, not a separate prompt spec, so it is not in justified_model_spend/cases.json; this file is its audit entry. Measured 2026-10-29 with claude -p (haiku), six cases, the shipped prompt with and without the section, same message.

cache.reading: The section sits in the cached prefix: the creation tokens are unchanged and all 623 added tokens were read from cache, so on a warm session they are billed at the cache-read rate.

added_output_tokens_per_reply.reading: Noisy (n=6, from minus 227 to plus 416): replies that add the pointer sentence are longer, replies that hold back are shorter.

dollars_per_reply.output: Not priced: the output price is not in quest_ai_runner/pricing.py, so the output change is reported in tokens only.

verdict: Justified at the measured size: about 623 input tokens a reply, about half a thousandth of a dollar uncached and about a twentieth of that cached, for a section that moves the two-sided value from 0.42 to 0.50 up to 0.79 on the tuning set and 0.83 to 0.92 on the held-out set. Flag: it is on every chat reply, including the many that need no pointer; if a cheap pre-check can tell those apart, the section could be added only where it matters.
